research_rationale: Every frozen scope is mapped to its legal provision in LIFECYCLE_ANALYSIS.json. This preserves the prior producer analysis while adding actual performance, judicial suspension, conditional CBA applications and separate regulatory consequences. Native exact first-ending fields remain unset where a composite duty, unknown performance date or injunction episode prevents a single supported date. The later formal revocation is retained as a confirmed proposed later event. No automatic revival is inferred from EO 14148. New sources require integration and independent review; approved remains false.

savings.reason: Original section 8 preserves statutory agency authority and OMB functions and creates no enforceable benefit. Petition records, proposed legislation and statutory agency powers can persist after EO revocation. EO 14029 contains no identified EO-specific savings. The full duration of residual consequences is unresolved.
